primary_objective: Expected assay-defined molar ORAC-FL capacity; not parent-molecule intrinsic radical stoichiometry
ranking_statistic: Predicted conditional mean capacity; uncertainty reported separately
model_sequence: Compound-only reference baseline where repeated data allow
Structure-based prediction only with adequate labels and applicability-domain validation

validation.primary_split: Leave one paper out; all doses/technical repeats from the same data-generating study stay together
validation.independence_audit: DOI is a provisional group key; shared/reused datasets must be linked before splitting
validation.structure_model_split: Additional chemical-scaffold grouping if a structural model is attempted
validation.tuning: Nested within training data; preprocessing and imputation fitted within training folds
metrics: Prediction interval coverage and width when intervals can be estimated
Rank concordance on held-out comparable compounds
Top-k stability under source and protocol sensitivity
validation.failure_reporting: Report unsupported folds and unseen compounds; never silently drop them

forbidden_shortcuts: Random row split across one paper
Assign SD or independent n from undefined plus-minus
Replace source conflicts with silent corrections
Journal IF or publication counts as potency labels
Adjust parameters to force a named compound into Top20
Assume ORAC-FL predicts absorbance endpoints without paired experiments
nonfluorescent_transfer: Separate future paired-assay calibration and held-out validation; no conversion coefficient assumed
stratification_policy: Source-reported final vehicle, AUC estimator and integration window define separate protocol strata; unknown stratum fields stay unresolved and are not assigned from another assay arm
